shift_protocol.question: Does split-conformal coverage hold year by year in 2020-2024, and does recalibration using only earlier years restore it?
shift_protocol.cleaning: drop crop labels matching 'total' or starting with 'other'; merge labels differing only by case or spacing into the id with most rows; on district-year overlap keep the dominant id's row
shift_protocol.aci_update: alpha_{t+1} = alpha_t + gamma * (alpha - yearly miscoverage_t), gamma in {0.1, 0.5}, both reported
shift_protocol.primary_metric: overall test coverage with 95% district-crop group bootstrap CI (500 replicates); secondary: mean width, coverage by year and province
